mapper.select: SELECT EMP_NO, EMP_NM, DEPT_CD, DEPT_DUTY, E_MAIL, MOBILE_NO, RETIRE_DATE, PASS, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM KYERP.TB_HR_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE AA.DEPT_CD = Y.DEPT_CD AND END_YMD = '99991231' ) DEPT_NM , (SELECT BASE_CD_NM FROM KYERP.TB_CM_CODE_DTL WHERE BASE_CD_GRP = 'HR0003' AND BASE_CD = Y.DEPT_DUTY) AS DEPT_DUTY_NM, DECODE(RETIRE_DATE,NULL,'Y','N') USE_YN, EMP_GRADE FROM CRM_EMP_MGT Y WHERE 1=1 AND EMP_NO = #{emp_no} AND PASS = #{pass}

SELECT A.AS_NO , A.ACCEPT_DT , A.ACCEPT_TIME , A.ACCEPT_ROUTE , B.CUST_KOR_NAME , A.CUST_CODE , B.CUST_ADDRESS , A.APPLY_NM , A.APPLY_ID , A.APPLY_TEL , A.ASSIGN_ID , A.SERVICE_CATE , C.CODE_NAME AS SERVICE_CATE_NM , A.INQUIRY_TYPE , D.CODE_NAME AS INQUIRY_TYPE_NM , A.CALL_CONTENT , A.PROC_STATUS , E.CODE_NAME AS PROC_STATUS_NM , A.INPORTANCE , F.CODE_NAME AS INPORTANCE_NM , A.PROC_DT , A.FILE_SEQ , A.ATTACH_SEQ2 , A.ACTION_TYPE , G.CODE_NAME AS ACTION_TYPE_NM FROM CRM_AS_MGT A , CRM_CUST_MGT B , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD03') C , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME, P_CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' ) D , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD01') E , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD04') F , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD06') G WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.DEL_YN IS NULL AND A.CUST_CODE = B.CRM_CODE (+) AND A.SERVICE_CATE = C.CODE (+) AND A.SERVICE_CATE = D.P_CODE (+) AND A.INQUIRY_TYPE = D.CODE (+) AND A.PROC_STATUS = E.CODE (+) AND A.INPORTANCE = F.CODE (+) AND A.ACTION_TYPE = G.CODE (+)
AND A.ASSIGN_ID LIKE NVL(#{search_type1}, '') || '%'
AND A.PROC_DT BETWEEN NVL(#{search_type2},'') AND NVL(#{search_type3},'')
AND A.AS_NO LIKE NVL(#{search_type4}, '') || '%'
ORDER BY A.AS_NO

SELECT A.AS_NO , DECODE (NVL(A.PROC_DT, ''), '', '', DECODE(NVL(A.PROC_TIME, '0000'), '', '' , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PROC_DT || ' ' || DECODE(A.PROC_TIME, 'nullnull', '0000'), 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') , 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) AS PROC_TIME , A.SERVICE_CATE , B.CODE_NAME AS SERVICE_CATE_NM , A.INQUIRY_TYPE , C.CODE_NAME AS INQUIRY_TYPE_NM , A.PROC_STATUS , D.CODE_NAME AS PROC_STATUS_NM , A.ACTION_CONTENT , A.CAUSE_TYPE , E.CODE_NAME AS CAUSE_TYPE_NM , A.ACTION_TYPE , F.CODE_NAME AS ACTION_TYPE_NM , A.CALL_CONTENT , A.ASSIGN_ID , A.INPORTANCE , I.CODE_NAME AS INPORTANCE_NM
FROM CRM_AS_MGT A , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD03') B , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME, P_CODE FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' ) C , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD01') D , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD05') E , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD06') F , (SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD04') I
WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.DEL_YN IS NULL AND A.SERVICE_CATE = B.CODE (+) AND A.SERVICE_CATE = C.P_CODE (+) AND A.INQUIRY_TYPE = C.CODE (+) AND A.PROC_STATUS = D.CODE (+) AND A.CAUSE_TYPE = E.CODE (+) AND A.ACTION_TYPE = F.CODE (+) AND A.INPORTANCE = I.CODE (+) AND A.ASSIGN_ID = NVL(#{search_type1}, '') AND A.CUST_CODE = NVL(#{search_type2}, '') ORDER BY A.AS_NO

SELECT SEQ ,AS_NO ,PROC_DT ,ACCEPTOR ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE 1=1 AND EMP_NO = ACCEPTOR) ACCEPTOR_NM ,PROC_STATUS ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP ='AS' AND P_CODE='CD01' AND CODE=PROC_STATUS) PROC_STATUS_NM ,ACTION_CONTENT ,FILE_SEQ ,REG_DATE ,REG_ID ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE 1=1 AND EMP_NO = REG_ID) REG_NM FROM CRM_AS_MGT_HIST WHERE 1=1 AND AS_NO = #{as_no, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC
SELECT CODE , CODE_NAME AS CODE_NM FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE = 'CD01'
SELECT CODE , CODE_NAME AS CODE_NM FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE = 'CD05'
SELECT CODE , CODE_NAME AS CODE_NM FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE = 'CD06'
SELECT CODE , CODE_NAME AS CODE_NM FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND P_CODE = 'CD04'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CRM_AS_MGT_HIST WHERE 1=1 AND (FILE_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND FILE_SEQ !='0') AND AS_NO = #{as_no}
SELECT * FROM CRM_AS_MGT_ANSWER WHERE 1=1 AND AS_NO = #{as_no}
